requirements.text: Implement the smallest deterministic read-only simplification review over the existing Experiment Lifecycle registry that flags semantic/path alias families, high-observation zero-outcome incubation and repeated matured-inconclusive families for governance review without automatically merging, retiring, promoting or changing weights.
Equivalent known path-alias candidates with the same kind/direction/horizon are grouped with every original candidate ID preserved.
The report separately flags high-observation zero-outcome incubation and repeated matured-inconclusive families.
Distinct hypotheses are not collapsed solely because they share a metric path.
No candidate is deleted, rewritten, auto-retired, auto-merged, promoted or assigned a model weight by the review.

scripts/experiments/directly related read-only experiment simplification review helper | tests/experiments/directly related simplification review tests | research/experiment_lifecycle/directly related generated simplification review artifact

market gates | model weights | canonical authority | portfolio logic | API budget | new policy semantics | automatic experiment retirement | automatic experiment merge | automatic promotion | candidate history deletion

evidence: PR #1280 merged at e01087b707f9c289470c3d0b454f32a286b9c2e3 after Data Architecture, Storage Health, Experiment Lifecycle and Automation Production Health gates passed.

Experiment Lifecycle Gate run 35934421463 executed the live-registry simplification tests plus all four entrypoint regressions: isolated unittest collection, direct script execution from outside the repo, module execution and current-registry CLI read-only behavior; all passed.

The live-registry regression preserves 387 registry rows, 379 unique candidate IDs and 8 duplicate-ID legacy families as explicit read-only diagnostics, runs deterministically twice and proves candidate JSON bytes are unchanged.
Exact semantic alias clustering uses the existing canonical normalization and full semantic identity; same target path alone remains insufficient merge authority.
Fresh main retains zero automatic merge, retirement, promotion, candidate-history mutation, market-gate, model-weight or portfolio authority.
